gen-mystery-quest-gf-mozilla-text: Nostalgic curves with open jaws lead in Mystery Quest. Mozilla Text follows in a sans with tall, sturdy-looking lowercase and flared terminals, so a body size a notch smaller still reads clearly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-nata-sans: Storybook charm meets crisp modern lines. Mystery Quest does its best work showing off those open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, while Nata Sans keeps a steady, pen-drawn hand with a big central band for everyday text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-nobile: Mystery Quest brings open-jawed curves and a bookish, old-timey feel. Nobile sits below in a plain sans, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, so paragraphs would move along smoothly with unjoined, chalk-arc letter mouths.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest curls its open-jawed strokes under compact ascenders. Noto Kufi Arabic is the one to lean on for modern, clean text, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals that barely rise above lowercase.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads wide and friendly, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Mystery Quest up top adds the bookish, open-jawed flavor, so a body size a little modest still stays easy on the eye.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with tall, full lowercase forms. Mystery Quest, meanwhile, is best at nostalgic, bookish display flair, and the sans-serif body is best at staying clean and contemporary.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined reads modern and businesslike, with little height gap between cases. Mystery Quest is the one made for bookish, nostalgic display, while the plain sans body quietly handles generous, open curves.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs has terminal tips pointing outward and an x-height rising close to the capitals. Mystery Quest above it feels bookish, so lines would flow along with ease.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Clean and modern, Noto Sans Arabic is the quiet partner here. Mystery Quest brings bookish, open-jawed nostalgia on top, and the sans-serif body backs it with wide openings and a pronounced x-height.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Approachable and businesslike, this pairing starts with open-jawed Mystery Quest at its most nostalgic. Noto Sans Armenian then handles the everyday text, with tall, full lowercase and inviting round letters in its sans-serif frame.
